errors.message: Invoice reference number (IRN) is required.
Due date must be on or after issue date.
Invoice type code is required.
Payment status must be one of PENDING, PARTIAL, PAID, or REJECTED.
Unsupported currency code.
Unsupported payment means code.
Deposit must be zero or greater.
Customer TIN is required.
Customer party name is required.
Invalid email format.
Telephone must include international dialing code, for example +2348033456789.
Customer street name is required.
Customer city is required.
Country must be a two-letter ISO code.
Product category is required.
Line item name is required.
Line item description is required.
HSN code is required.
Price unit is required.
Quantity must be greater than zero.
Invoiced quantity must be positive and monetary values must be non-negative.
Percentage rates must be between zero and 100.
Unit price must be zero or greater.
Tax rate must be between 0 and 100.
Discount value must be zero or greater.
Discount type must be Percent or Flat.
Tax category must use uppercase letters and underscores.
Reference must contain between 1 and 200 characters.
Original line references are only supported on Credit Notes.
ERP row references must be unique within the document.
Total amount does not match the tax-inclusive line item totals.
